content: Supplement tracking exists as a niche app category: SuppCo (stack builder, smart daily schedule and reminders, barcode add), Re:Stock (purpose-built stock countdown per bottle with dynamic reorder list and low-stock prioritization), Pillo (stock alerts plus timing conflict chart), CareClinic and MyTherapy (refill alerts, logbooks). Mainstream macro trackers (MyFitnessPal, MacroFactor) do not cover supplements with stock control; combining daily checklist plus inventory plus weekly report is uncommon.
